R06.source: public static boolean ready(SQLiteDatabase db){try(Cursor c=db.rawQuery("SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('r30r1_analysis_run','r30r1_research_measure','r30r1_proposal','r30r1_consume','r30r1_chart_cache','r30r1_task_progress')",null)){return c.moveToFirst()&&c.getLong(0)==6;}}
